title: Durian
paragraphs: Durian is nicknamed the “king of fruits” for its large size, thorny rind, and strong aroma. Inside, the custardy flesh is beloved by fans for its rich, sweet, and slightly savory notes.
Different varieties vary in sweetness, bitterness, and texture. While some places ban it indoors due to the smell, durian remains a treasured seasonal treat across Southeast Asia.
